sentences: Width-four ordered branching programs read bits in sequence while remembering only one of four states.
The saved source asks for pseudorandom generators with seed length below the log-squared scale.
Even this very small state space can repeatedly combine and discard information from earlier bits.
An improvement would test whether general space-bounded pseudorandomness barriers already occur at constant width.
